_comment: 'When this attacks, if the last action card you played this turn was Lightning, THIS and the next action card you play this turn get go again.' Go again is PRINTED, so the card had it whether or not a Lightning action preceded it. The ON_ATTACK trigger already grants it back under the right condition, and also hands one to the next action card; only the printed one needed stripping. Declared rather than converted because the grant is half of a two-target clause and a WHILE_STATIC covers only this card.
